beginner.en: The process of evaluating a software product to identify defects.
beginner.hi: Software mein galtiyan dhoondhne ka process.
beginner.ex: Clicking all buttons to see if they work.

beginner.en: A deviation from expected behavior in a software application.
beginner.hi: Jab software waisa kaam na kare jaisa usse karna chahiye.

beginner.en: A framework defining tasks performed at each step in the software development process.
beginner.hi: Software banane ka pura process, step-by-step.

beginner.en: A sequence of specific activities performed during the testing process.
beginner.hi: Testing karne ka pura process, step-by-step.
beginner.ex: Requirement Analysis -> Test Planning -> Test Execution.

beginner.en: A detailed set of steps to test a specific functionality.
beginner.hi: Kisi feature ko test karne ke liye step-by-step instructions.
beginner.ex: Steps to login: 1. Open URL, 2. Enter username, 3. Enter password, 4. Click Login.

beginner.en: Adapting software to the language, culture, and legal requirements of a target locale.
beginner.hi: App ko kisi khas language ya region ke hisab se dhaalna.

beginner.en: Designing and developing a product so that it can be localized for different cultures.
beginner.hi: Product ko aise design karna ki wo kisi bhi language mein support ho sake.

beginner.en: Testing with partial knowledge of internal logic or database structures.
beginner.hi: Jab tester ko code aur functionality dono ki thodi knowledge ho.
beginner.ex: Checking if a form saves to the specific DB table.

beginner.en: Unpredictable inputs used to check if the app can handle random user behavior.
beginner.hi: Bina kisi plan ke random clicks/data se system check karna.
beginner.ex: Rapidly clicking buttons on a slow device.

beginner.en: Informal testing performed without following any test cases or requirement docs.
beginner.hi: Bina kisi document ke apni samajh se app ko check karna.
beginner.ex: Randomly trying site features during a break.

beginner.en: Narrow focus on a specific functionality to ensure it works after changes.
beginner.hi: Bugs fix hone ke baad kisi khas feature ki basic health check.
beginner.ex: Checking Logout button after Header update.

beginner.en: Verifies basic stability (e.g., Can it launch? Can we login?) before deep testing.
beginner.hi: Build aate hi basic stability (Login/Home) check karna.
beginner.ex: Checking if app opens properly on a new build.

beginner.en: Testing the 'what' of the software (features, inputs, outputs).
beginner.hi: App ke features (Kya kaam ho raha hai) ko check karna.

beginner.en: A flaw found by testers before the product goes live.
beginner.hi: Jab result waisa na aaye jaisa documents mein manga tha.

beginner.en: A human action that produces an incorrect result (e.g., typo in code).
beginner.hi: Coder ya tester ki insani galti jo baad mein bug banti hai.

beginner.en: Ensuring that recent code changes haven't broken existing features.
beginner.hi: Jo bug report kiya tha, uske fix hone ke baad dobara check karna.

beginner.en: Testing without executing the code (Verification).
beginner.hi: Bina app chalaye requirements aur code review karna.
beginner.ex: Reading Requirement Docs to find gaps.

beginner.en: Testing with inputs that are expected to work correctly.
beginner.hi: Sahi data daal kar check karna ki system kaam kar raha hai.

beginner.en: Ensures the whole system works together (e.g., login to checkout).
beginner.hi: Pura system shuru se anth tak check karna.

beginner.en: Testing with incorrect inputs to ensure the system handles errors.
beginner.hi: Galat data daal kar check karna ki error message aata hai ya nahi.
beginner.ex: Entering 'abc' in a Moble Number field.

beginner.q: What is the primary goal of UAT?
beginner.en: User Acceptance Testing ensures the tool is fit for business use.
beginner.hi: UAT check karta hai ki product client ki requirements poori karta hai.
beginner.ex: Client testing the app before final handover.

beginner.en: Randomly entering data to check system robustness.
beginner.hi: Bina kisi plan ke random data daal kar system ki majbooti check karna.
beginner.ex: Repeatedly clicking buttons to see if it hangs.

beginner.en: Tester has partial knowledge of internal structures (e.g., DB schema).
beginner.hi: Black aur White box ka mishran; isme thodi internal knowledge hoti hai.
beginner.ex: Checking database entries after submitting a form.

beginner.en: Informal testing performed without any documentation or plan.
beginner.hi: Bina kisi document ya planning ke randomly test karna.
beginner.ex: Trying random features on a lunch break.

beginner.en: I18n makes the app capable of global use; L10n adapts it for a specific locale.
beginner.hi: I18n matlab app ko global banana, L10n matlab kisi khas area/language ke liye dhaalna.

beginner.en: A high-priority fix for a production issue.
beginner.hi: Live software mein aayi badi galti ko turant theek karna.
beginner.ex: Fixing a checkout crash on a live site.

beginner.en: A bug that hasn't been found yet because the feature or conditions weren't met.
beginner.hi: Aisa bug jo chhupa hua hai aur kisi khas vajah se hi dikhta hai.
beginner.ex: Bug that appears only on February 29th.

beginner.en: Verification checks process/docs; Validation checks the final software.
beginner.hi: Verification: Kya hum sahi process follow kar rahe? Validation: Kya client ki zaroorat poori hui?
beginner.ex: Reviewing specs vs Running the login.

beginner.q: What is the status 'Deferred' in Bug Life Cycle?
beginner.en: A bug that is acknowledged but scheduled for a later release.
beginner.hi: Bug hai par ise agle version mein theek kiya jayega.
beginner.ex: Small spelling error deferred to v2.0.

beginner.en: A flexible and iterative development approach.
beginner.hi: Kaam ko chhote hisson mein baant kar step-by-step deliver karna.

beginner.en: A task focused on research or prototyping rather than coding a feature.
beginner.hi: Kisi nayi cheez ko samajhne ke liye kiya gaya research task.

beginner.en: The ability to track requirements through design to testing.
beginner.hi: Pata lagana ki har requirement test case se judi hai ya nahi.

beginner.en: A plain-text language with structure for defining test scenarios.
beginner.hi: Simple English format (Given-When-Then) jisme tests likhe jaate hain.
beginner.ex: Given user is on login page...

beginner.en: Focuses on testing one value from each group of inputs that behave same.
beginner.hi: Inputs ko un groups mein baantna jo same result dete hon.

beginner.en: Set of conditions that a software product must meet to be accepted by a customer.
beginner.hi: Woh conditions jo poori hone par client software ko accept karega.
beginner.ex: User must be able to login within 2 seconds.

beginner.en: An unexpected termination of a software program.
beginner.hi: Jab software chalte-chalte bina kisi warning ke band ho jaye.
beginner.ex: App closing when clicking on Profile.

beginner.en: The individual for whom the product is designed and developed.
beginner.hi: Woh asli insaan jo software ko use karega.
beginner.ex: A bank customer using an ATM.

beginner.en: A version of software code that has been compiled and is ready for use.
beginner.hi: Software ka ek version jo test karne layak ho gaya ho.
beginner.ex: Build v1.0.1 received from Dev team.

beginner.en: A formal document describing a bug found during testing.
beginner.hi: Bug ki saari jaankari dene wala document.

beginner.en: Describes a specific behavior or function of the system.
beginner.hi: Software kya kaam karega (features), uski jaankari.
beginner.ex: System should allow users to reset passwords.

beginner.en: Describes the quality attributes of the system.
beginner.hi: Software kaise kaam karega (speed, security), uski jaankari.
beginner.ex: System should load in under 2 seconds.

beginner.en: The process of identifying what the client wants from the software.
beginner.hi: Client se unki zaroorat (requirements) puchne ka process.

beginner.en: The series of screens, pages, and visual elements that you use to interact with a device.
beginner.hi: Software ka wo hissa jo user ko dikhta hai.

beginner.en: How a user feels when interacting with a system.
beginner.hi: Software use karte waqt user ko kaisa feel hota hai (asaan ya mushkil).
beginner.ex: Making sure the 'Buy' button is easy to find.

beginner.en: A bug that appears in a previously working feature.
beginner.hi: Naye badlav ki vajah se purane features ka kharab ho jana.
beginner.ex: Adding a new filter broke the Search button.

beginner.en: Indicates how urgently a bug needs to be fixed.
beginner.hi: Bug ko kitni jaldi theek karne ki zaroorat hai.
beginner.ex: High priority: Logo is wrong on home page.

beginner.en: Indicates how badly the bug affects the system operation.
beginner.hi: Bug system ko kitna zyada nuksan pahuncha raha hai.
beginner.ex: High severity: App crashes on startup.

beginner.en: Testing the application from a user's perspective for ease of use.
beginner.hi: Ye check karna ki app user ke liye kitni aasan hai.
beginner.ex: Asking a user to find a product in under 1 minute.

beginner.en: The ability of a system to perform its required functions under stated conditions for a specified period.
beginner.hi: Software bina fail hue kitni der sahi chal sakta hai.

beginner.en: How easily an application can be moved from one OS/Browser to another.
beginner.hi: Software ko ek jagah se doosri jagah (OS/Device) shift karna kitna aasan hai.
beginner.ex: Running Windows app on Linux using wine.

beginner.en: Checking if site works for screen readers, keyboard-only users, etc.
beginner.hi: Yeh check karna ki divyang (disabled) log app use kar payein.

intermediate.en: Testing values at the boundaries of equivalence classes (e.g., 0, 1, 100).
intermediate.hi: Inputs ki boundaries (kinaron) pe test karna (like -1, 0, 1).

intermediate.en: Dividing input data into classes where one value represents the class.
intermediate.hi: Inputs ko groups mein baantna jo same result dein.
intermediate.ex: Testing one value (e.g., 25) for age group 18-60.

intermediate.q: What is an RTM (Requirement Traceability Matrix)?
intermediate.en: Ensures every requirement has at least one associated test case.
intermediate.hi: Requirement ko Test Case ke saath map karna taaki kuch miss na ho.

intermediate.q: What is the difference between Verification and Validation?
intermediate.en: Verification (Process) vs Validation (Final Product).
intermediate.hi: Verification: Kya hum sahi bana rahe hain? Validation: Kya humne sahi banaya?
intermediate.ex: Reviewing code vs Running the app.

intermediate.en: A defect in code leads to a failure in the environment.
intermediate.hi: Code ki galti Defect hai, aur jab app chalne mein galti kare toh Failure.
intermediate.ex: A syntax error causing a crash.

intermediate.en: A subset of regression focusing on specific component changes.
intermediate.hi: Bugs fix hone ke baad kuch khas features ki health check karna.
intermediate.ex: Checking Payment module after a small update.

intermediate.en: Testing on the fly based on experience and intuition.
intermediate.hi: Bina fixed steps ke apni samajh se app ko explore aur test karna.
intermediate.ex: Tester randomly trying scenarios to find complex bugs.

intermediate.q: Define Test Scenario vs Test Case.
intermediate.en: Scenario is high-level; Test Case is detailed with steps.
intermediate.hi: Scenario matlab kya test karna hai, Case matlab kaise (steps).
intermediate.ex: Scenario: Forget Password; Case: Enter email, click link...

intermediate.en: Tests lose effectiveness over time and need regular updates.
intermediate.hi: Ek hi tests baar-baar chalane se naye bugs nahi milte.
intermediate.ex: Updating the regression suite every sprint.

intermediate.q: What is the difference between Error, Bug, and Defect?
intermediate.en: Error is human mistake; Bug is found by users/QA; Defect is the technical flaw.
intermediate.hi: Error insani galti hai, Bug QA ne pakda, Defect code ki khami hai.
intermediate.ex: Typo in code leads to a Bug in UI.

intermediate.en: A major functionality is blocked and there is no alternative.
intermediate.hi: Jab koi main feature bilkul kaam na kare aur koi rasta na ho.

intermediate.en: Verifies the entire system flow including external integrations.
intermediate.hi: Shuru se ant tak pura process test karna.
intermediate.ex: Login -> Search -> Add to Cart -> Payment -> Invoice.

intermediate.en: Checks how the system works (Speed, Load, Security).
intermediate.hi: Jo features ke bajaye quality/speed check kare (like load testing).
intermediate.ex: Checking if site loads in 2 seconds.

intermediate.en: Helps identify which modules are the weakest/most problematic.
intermediate.hi: Ye batata hai ki code ke size ke hisab se kitne bugs hain.
intermediate.ex: Module A has 10 bugs per 1000 lines of code.

intermediate.en: A comprehensive document that describes the objectives, scope, and methods for testing a software product.
intermediate.hi: Testing kaise hogi, kya test hoga, kaun karega, kab tak hoga - sab batane wala document.
intermediate.ex: A document detailing the strategy for testing a new mobile app.

intermediate.en: A high-level plan that defines the testing types, levels, and objectives for a project.
intermediate.hi: Testing ki badi picture, jaise kaun se types ki testing hogi (manual, automation, performance).
intermediate.ex: Deciding to use Agile testing methodology for the project.

intermediate.en: A collection of software and test data configured to test a program unit by simulating the environment.
intermediate.hi: Ek setup jismein test karne ke liye code, data aur tools hote hain.
intermediate.ex: Using JUnit with mock objects to test a specific class.

intermediate.en: A dummy program that integrates with the module under test and provides the same output as the actual module.
intermediate.hi: Ek chhota sa nakli program jo asli module ki tarah kaam karta hai, jab asli module ready na ho.
intermediate.ex: A stub for a payment gateway that always returns 'success'.

intermediate.en: A program that calls the module under test, passes test data, and prints results.
intermediate.hi: Ek program jo asli module ko chalata hai aur usko data dekar check karta hai.
intermediate.ex: A main method calling a utility function with various inputs.

intermediate.en: Describes the interaction between a user and the system to achieve a specific goal.
intermediate.hi: User kaise system ko use karke apna kaam karega, uska description.
intermediate.ex: 'Place an Order' use case for an e-commerce site.

intermediate.en: QA prevents defects; QC identifies them in the final product.
intermediate.hi: QA bugs aane se rokta hai, QC unhe check karke dhoondhta hai.

intermediate.en: Practically impossible but theoretically testing everything.
intermediate.hi: Har possible value aur condition ko test karna (jo mushkil hai).

intermediate.en: Stubs simulate lower modules; Drivers simulate higher modules.
intermediate.hi: Stub neeche wale module ki jagah, Driver upar wale ki jagah.

intermediate.en: Ensures the system doesn't crash on invalid data and gives errors.
intermediate.hi: Ye dekhna ki galat data par app sahi error message deti hai ya nahi.

intermediate.en: Short set of tests to ensure build is stable enough to test further.
intermediate.hi: Badi testing shuru karne se pehle zaroori features ki check.

intermediate.en: Smoke is general health check; Sanity is for a specific fix validation.
intermediate.hi: Smoke puri build ki health hai, Sanity ek khas feature ki fix check.
intermediate.ex: Fresh build (Smoke) vs Bug fix check (Sanity).

intermediate.en: No prepared script; tester uses their experience to find edge cases.
intermediate.hi: Bina kisi document ke apni akal se software ko xplore karna.
intermediate.ex: Trying random weird inputs to crash UI.

intermediate.en: Alpha is done at developer site; Beta is done at client site/real environment.
intermediate.hi: Alpha office mein hota hai, Beta asli users ke saath bahar.

intermediate.en: Ensures the app looks and works same across Chrome, Safari, etc.
intermediate.hi: Alag browsers/mobile phones par app chalana.
intermediate.ex: Checking site layout on iPhone vs Android.

intermediate.en: A list of everything that's known to be needed in the product.
intermediate.hi: Un kamo ki list jo team ko aage karne hain.
intermediate.ex: User stories for the next 3 sprints.

intermediate.en: A core unit of development in Scrum.
intermediate.hi: Ek nichit samay (usually 2-4 hafte) jisme kaam deliver karna hota hai.

intermediate.en: Short (15-min) sync meeting for the team.
intermediate.hi: Rozana ki 15-minute ki meeting kaam update karne ke liye.
intermediate.ex: What did I do yesterday? What will I do today?

intermediate.en: The most popular framework for implementing Agile.
intermediate.hi: Agile follow karne ka ek badhiya tareeka.
intermediate.ex: Using Sprints, Daily Standups, and Backlog.

intermediate.en: Responsible for maximizing the value of the product.
intermediate.hi: Client ki taraf se requirement samjhane aur prioritize karne wala insaan.
intermediate.ex: PO deciding which feature is most important.

intermediate.en: The coach who helps the team use the Scrum framework.
intermediate.hi: Wo insaan jo team ki rukawatein (blockers) door karta hai.

intermediate.en: Visual tool to track sprint progress.
intermediate.hi: Ye dekhne ka chart ki sprint mein kitna kaam bacha hai.
intermediate.ex: Line going down as tasks complete.

intermediate.en: Helps in planning future sprints based on past performance.
intermediate.hi: Team ek sprint mein kitna kaam kar sakti hai, uska score.
intermediate.ex: Team average velocity is 30 story points.

intermediate.en: Ensures quality and clarity on when a task is finished.
intermediate.hi: Kaam pura kab mana jayega, uska shared criteria.
intermediate.ex: Code reviewed, Unit tested, and QA passed.

intermediate.en: Future rework needed because of shortcuts taken during development.
intermediate.hi: Rasta chota lene ki vajah se baad mein hone wala extra kaam.

intermediate.en: Simulating a component for testing (e.g., using a fake DB).
intermediate.hi: Asli cheez ki jagah nakli setup use karna test karne ke liye.

intermediate.en: Creating a version of data used for testing that protects PII.
intermediate.hi: Asli data ko badal kar nakli banana taaki privacy bani rahe.

intermediate.en: Testing the most common, error-free path through an app.
intermediate.hi: Sabse aasan aur bina error wala flow check karna.

intermediate.en: Informal technique where experience is used to find bugs.
intermediate.hi: Apne purane tajurbe se ye andaza lagana ki bug kahan ho sakta hai.
intermediate.ex: Checking for 0 or negative values in a calculation field.

intermediate.en: White box technique ensuring all control paths are tested.
intermediate.hi: Code ke har raaste (logic) ko test karna.

intermediate.en: Testing every possible branch from each decision point.
intermediate.hi: Conditions ke har possible outcome (True/False) ko check karna.
intermediate.ex: Testing both Success and Error flows of a form.

intermediate.en: Deliberately changing code to see if tests fail.
intermediate.hi: Jaan bujh kar code badalna taaki pata chale tests asardaar hain ya nahi.

intermediate.en: Expert-driven usability check against set rules.
intermediate.hi: Maahir logo dwara standard rules ke hisab se UI check karna.
intermediate.ex: Checking if 'Cancel' button is near 'OK' button.

intermediate.en: Statistical method to reduce number of test cases while maintaining coverage.
intermediate.hi: Do-do parameters ke combinations bana kar test karna.

intermediate.en: Test Log: Chronological record; Incidence Report: Deviation from expected behavior.
intermediate.hi: Test Log rozana ka record hai, Incidence Report kisi khas bug ki detail.

intermediate.en: Ensures that all paths through a module are executed.
intermediate.hi: Code ke andar ke logic aur paths (control) ko test karna.

advanced.q: What is the V-Model in Testing?
advanced.en: Assocaites every development phase with a corresponding test phase.
advanced.hi: Har development step ke saath ek testing step parallel chalta hai.

advanced.en: Focusing core efforts on features most likely to fail or cause damage.
advanced.hi: Zahan zyada risk hai, wahan pehle aur zyada testing karna.
advanced.ex: Testing Payment gateway before About Us page.

advanced.en: Using combinations of inputs (Rules) to verify complex behaviors.
advanced.hi: Alag-alag conditions ke results ko matrix format mein test karna.
advanced.ex: Testing login with 2FA, Remember Me, etc.

advanced.en: Changes (mutants) are made to source code to verify test case quality.
advanced.hi: Code mein jaan-bujh kar galti karna dekhne ke liye ki tests use pakadte hain ya nahi.
advanced.ex: Changing a '+' to '-' in code to see if tests fail.

advanced.q: Difference between Static Analysis and Code Review?
advanced.en: Static analysis uses tools (like SonarQube); Reviews are manual peer checks.
advanced.hi: Static Analysis tools karte hain, Code Review log (Peer Review).
advanced.ex: SonarQube vs Github Pull Request review.

advanced.q: What is Bottom-Up vs Top-Down Integration?
advanced.en: Approaches to combine units and test them as a group.
advanced.hi: Components ko jodte waqt pehle bade modular level pe test karna ya chhote units se.

advanced.en: Focuses on flexibility, collaboration, and rapid delivery (Sprints).
advanced.hi: Chhote-chhote hisson mein kaam divide karke jaldi deliver karna.

advanced.en: Format: As a [user], I want [action], so that [value].
advanced.hi: Ek feature ki requirement jo user ke nazariye se likhi ho.
advanced.ex: 'As a shopper, I want a Search bar so I can find products'.

advanced.en: Highest priority bug that prevents any further progress.
advanced.hi: Aisa bug jo aage ki testing hi rok de.

advanced.en: Two people (e.g., a tester and a developer) testing together to find more defects.
advanced.hi: Do log milkar ek hi cheez ko test karte hain, ek idea deta hai, dusra execute karta hai.
advanced.ex: A developer and a QA engineer collaborating on a complex feature.

advanced.en: Ensuring that the right test data is available for testing at the right time.
advanced.hi: Testing ke liye sahi data ko banana, store karna aur manage karna.
advanced.ex: Creating masked production data for UAT environment.

advanced.en: Integrating testing into the early stages of the software development lifecycle.
advanced.hi: Testing ko development process mein jaldi shuru karna, taaki bugs pehle mil jaayen.
advanced.ex: Developers writing unit tests before integration.

advanced.en: Suggests having more low-level tests (unit) and fewer high-level tests (UI).
advanced.hi: Testing ko alag-alag levels mein baantna, jaise zyada unit tests aur kam UI tests.
advanced.ex: Many unit tests, fewer integration tests, very few UI tests.

advanced.en: A defect that is so severe it halts the entire project or prevents a release.
advanced.hi: Ek aisa bug jo software ko release hone se rok de, bahut serious.
advanced.ex: The entire application crashes on startup in production environment.

advanced.en: A structured, formal inspection process for finding defects in documents and code.
advanced.hi: Documents aur code ko systematically review karne ka ek formal tareeka.
advanced.ex: A team meeting to formally review a design document for errors.

advanced.en: Useful for systems with complex flows (e.g., ATM, Booking).
advanced.hi: Jab system ek status se doosre par jaye, use check karna.

advanced.en: Used to test large number of input combinations efficiently.
advanced.hi: Kam cases mein zyada data combos cover karne ka mathematical tareeka.

advanced.en: Ethical hacking to check for vulnerabilities.
advanced.hi: System ki suraksha check karne ke liye 'hacking' style testing.
advanced.ex: Trying to bypass login via SQL injection.

advanced.en: Quantitative measure of code complexity (more paths = more risk).
advanced.hi: Code kitna uljha hua hai, uska ek mathematical score.
advanced.ex: Score > 10 means code is complex and risky.

advanced.en: Code works on different hardware platforms without recompilation.
advanced.hi: Ek hi software files ka alag computers pe sahi chalna.

advanced.en: Time taken for a packet to travel from source to destination.
advanced.hi: Request bhejne aur server ke sunne ke beech ka gap.

advanced.en: Load checks normal peak performance; Stress checks stability at limit.
advanced.hi: Load: 100 log; Stress: 10,000 log jab tak site fat na jaye.
advanced.ex: Normal sale vs Black Friday peak.

advanced.en: Checking if the system can handle sudden bursts of traffic.
advanced.hi: Ek dum se bahut saare users aane par system check karna.

advanced.en: Ensures that the app can be expanded (e.g., adding more RAM/nodes).
advanced.hi: Ye check karna ki kya app ko bada karna (scale) aasan hai.

advanced.en: Measures the probability of failure-free operation.
advanced.hi: Bina kisi rukawat ke software kitni der sahi chalta hai.
advanced.ex: Running a site for 72 hours without crash.

advanced.en: Focuses on data exchange between different systems.
advanced.hi: Alag-alag systems ke beech data transfer aur communication check karna.
advanced.ex: Checking if app works with PayPal API.

advanced.en: Usually expressed in 'nines' (e.g., 99.9% availability).
advanced.hi: System kitne samay tak users ke liye upalabdh (available) rehta hai.

advanced.en: The system should have redundancy to handle failures.
advanced.hi: Kuch hissa kharab hone par bhi system ka band na hona.
advanced.ex: Two servers running; if one fails, other takes over.

advanced.en: Checks for data loss, duplication, or corruption during transfers.
advanced.hi: Ye check karna ki data poore process mein sahi aur surakshit rahe.
advanced.ex: Transferring money and checking both accounts.

advanced.en: Validating against standards like HIPAA (Health) or GDPR (Privacy).
advanced.hi: Technical aur sarkari rules (standards) ke hisab se software check karna.
advanced.ex: Checking if site follows GDPR privacy rules.

advanced.en: Protecting data and preventing unauthorized access.
advanced.hi: Data ko chori hone se rokna aur system surakshit rakhna.

advanced.en: Using tools to scan for common security weaknesses like SQLi.
advanced.hi: Tools ke zariye security ki kamzoriyan dhoondna.
advanced.ex: Using OWASP ZAP to scan for risks.

advanced.en: Ensures that concurrent threads don't cause bottlenecks or deadlocks.
advanced.hi: Multiple processes jab saath chalein toh system check karna.

advanced.en: A statistical measure of reliability.
advanced.hi: Do failures ke beech ka average samay.
advanced.ex: If a system fails every 1000 hours, MTBF is 1000.

advanced.en: Measures how quickly a team can recover from a failure.
advanced.hi: Galti theek karne mein lagne wala average samay.

advanced.en: Focuses on business continuity after a major incident.
advanced.hi: Main system jam hone par backup se system chalane ki check.
advanced.ex: Simulating server room fire and restoring from cloud.

advanced.en: Important for security and compliance to see who did what.
advanced.hi: Kaun kab aur kya badlav kar raha hai, uska pura record.
advanced.ex: Logging which admin changed user permissions.

advanced.en: Checks for data loss, mapping issues, and formatting during migration.
advanced.hi: Purane system se naye system mein data shift karte waqt ki testing.
advanced.ex: Moving 1M users from Oracle to MongoDB.

advanced.en: Helps in verifying translations and regional UI layouts.
advanced.hi: Translation aur alag languages ke UI ko check karne wale tools.
advanced.ex: Using a tool to check Hindi fonts alignment.

advanced.en: Tester looks at both code logic and final UI functionality.
advanced.hi: Code aur user features dono ki thodi-thodi jankari hona.
advanced.ex: Reviewing DB while testing a form.

advanced.en: Helps identify which parts of code are NOT tested.
advanced.hi: Kitna percent code tests dwara chalaya (check kiya) gaya.

advanced.en: Branch coverage is more complex and effective than statement coverage.
advanced.hi: Branch har condition check karti hai, Statement har line.

advanced.en: Aims to test every independent path in the code at least once.

beginner.q: Which command removes data permanently (no rollback)?
beginner.en: TRUNCATE is DDL and doesn't support easy rollback.
beginner.hi: TRUNCATE furan pura table khali karta hai bina log ke.

beginner.q: Which SQL command is used to retrieve data from a database?
beginner.en: The SELECT statement is used to fetch data from a database.
beginner.hi: Database se data nikalne ke liye SELECT command use karte hain.

beginner.q: Which SQL command is used to add new rows of data to a table?
beginner.en: The INSERT INTO statement is used to add new records to a table.
beginner.hi: Table mein naya data daalne ke liye INSERT INTO use karte hain.

beginner.q: Which SQL command is used to modify existing data in a table?
beginner.en: The UPDATE statement is used to modify the existing records in a table.
beginner.hi: Table mein maujood data ko badalne ke liye UPDATE use karte hain.
beginner.ex: UPDATE Customers SET City = 'New York' WHERE CustomerID = 1;

beginner.q: Which SQL command is used to delete rows of data from a table?
beginner.en: The DELETE FROM statement is used to delete existing records in a table.
beginner.hi: Table se data ki rows mitane ke liye DELETE FROM use karte hain.

beginner.en: SQL is a standard language for storing, manipulating and retrieving data in databases.
beginner.hi: SQL ka matlab hai Structured Query Language.
beginner.ex: Learning SQL to interact with databases.

beginner.q: Which clause is used to filter records based on a specified condition?
beginner.en: The WHERE clause is used to extract only those records that fulfill a specified condition.
beginner.hi: Records ko filter karne ke liye WHERE clause use karte hain.

beginner.q: Which keyword is used to sort the result-set of a query?
beginner.en: The ORDER BY keyword is used to sort the result-set in ascending or descending order.
beginner.hi: Query ke results ko sort karne ke liye ORDER BY use karte hain.
beginner.ex: SELECT Name FROM Employees ORDER BY LastName DESC;

beginner.q: What is a 'Primary Key' in SQL?
beginner.en: A column (or set of columns) that uniquely identifies each row in a table.
beginner.hi: Ek column jo table mein har record ko alag pehchan deta hai.

beginner.q: What is a 'Foreign Key' in SQL?
beginner.en: A field (or collection of fields) in one table that refers to the primary key in another table.
beginner.hi: Ek table ka column jo doosre table ki Primary Key se link hota hai.
beginner.ex: OrderID in an OrderDetails table linking to OrderID in an Orders table.

beginner.en: DELETE logs each row; TRUNCATE resets the table and is faster.
beginner.hi: DELETE mein undo ho sakta hai, TRUNCATE pura tabela khali kar deta hai bina logging ke.

beginner.en: Prevents duplicate entries in a specific field.
beginner.hi: Ye check karta hai ki column mein har value alag ho.

beginner.en: Ensures that a column cannot have a NULL value.
beginner.hi: Ye column khali nahi choda ja sakta.

beginner.en: Used to fetch data spread across different tables.
beginner.hi: Do ya zyada tables ka data jodkar ek saath result dikhana.

beginner.en: Simplest join to get matching data only.
beginner.hi: Sirf woh records dikhana jo dono tables mein match karte hain.

beginner.en: Keeps all left records even if no match on right.
beginner.hi: Left side ke saare records aur right side ke matching records.

beginner.en: Keeps all right records even if no match on left.
beginner.hi: Right side ke saare records aur left side ke matching records.

beginner.hi: Dono tables ke saare records dikhana.

beginner.hi: GROUP BY ke baad results ko filter karne ke liye use hota hai.

beginner.en: Wildcard for exactly one character.
beginner.hi: Sirf ek character ke liye wildcard.

beginner.en: Shorthand for multiple OR conditions.
beginner.hi: Multiple values mein se search karne ka asan tareeka.

beginner.en: Inclusive of start and end values.
beginner.hi: Ek range ke beech ki values dhoondhne ke liye.

beginner.en: Makes query results easier to read.
beginner.hi: Table ya column ko testing ke liye ek temporary naam dena.

beginner.en: The inner query runs first.
beginner.hi: Ek query ke andar doosri query.

beginner.en: Used to finish a successful transaction.
beginner.hi: Badlav ko database mein pakka (save) karna.

beginner.en: Restores DB specifically to the last COMMIT.

beginner.en: Speeds up reads but slows down writes (Insert/Update).
beginner.hi: Data jaldi dhoondhne ke liye banayi gayi index.

beginner.hi: Woh column jo Primary Key banne ke layak ho.

beginner.en: Used when one column is not enough to identify a row uniquely.

beginner.en: Dividing large tables into smaller ones and linking them.
beginner.hi: Database design ko behtar banana taaki data repeat na ho.

intermediate.hi: Text mein pattern dhoondhne ke liye LIKE operator use hota hai.

intermediate.q: Which join returns all rows from the left table and matching rows from the right?

intermediate.hi: Ek query ke andar doosri query jo pehle chalti hai.

intermediate.en: Used when one column is not enough to identify a row uniquely.

intermediate.en: % for multi char, _ for single char.

intermediate.en: Allows multiple users to work on different rows at once.
